# Yugo v1.0.4 - Table of Contents

Yugo is an easy and high-level IMAP client library.

## Pages

- [Yugo](https://yugo.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Yugo](https://yugo.hexdocs.pm/Yugo.md): Auxiliary functions for Yugo.

- [Yugo.Client](https://yugo.hexdocs.pm/Yugo.Client.md): A persistent connection to an IMAP server.
- [Yugo.Filter](https://yugo.hexdocs.pm/Yugo.Filter.md): A construct that enables you to specify which emails you would
like a [`Client`](https://yugo.hexdocs.pm/`Yugo.Client`) to notify you about.
